# 4 bed bungalow for sale

> Moran Auctioneers are delighted to present No. 28 Knights Park, a spacious four-bedroom detached bungalow ideally situated in a well-established Tesidential area within easy walking distance of Castlebar Town Centre. The property offers bright, well-proportioned accommodation comprising a generous Living Room, Fitted Kitchen, Separate Utility, Four bedrooms (one Ensuite) and a family Bathroom.
